audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was 'Skill' though whys[1] says the trades tilt your way; Level 6 was given to Lillia though whys[4] says your R field keeps the lane in your favour; First item was Illaoi though whys[5] says it evens out; 2+ items was Illaoi though whys[6] and late both say she out-scales and never stands in the tentacles. diffRating 7.5/10 also contradicts diff FAV and a 52.92% win rate.
audit.why: Packet chart: Lillia, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Lillia — which is exactly what the prose already describes.
audit.corrected: Level 2 -> Illaoi, Level 6 -> Illaoi, First item -> Skill, 2+ items -> Lillia, both layers, ratings moved. diffRating 7.5/10 -> 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; Blooming Blows was described only as 'her kite + move speed stacks'.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Watch Out! Eep! 14/13/12/11/10s, Swirlseed a flat 12s, Lilting Lullaby 150/130/110s. Your Harsh Lesson is a flat 4s, which is the concrete answer to her move-speed stacking.
audit.corrected: Blooming Blows' 6s written into the do's; Harsh Lesson's 4s re-leap written into what you want.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names and one fabricated mechanic. 'Blooming Blast' (spikes[3], wants.foe[0]) and 'Lilting Aria' (spikes[1], wants.foe[1]) do not exist. The page also described 'Q bounces' and told the reader to 'use W to stick after she Q-dashes away' — Blooming Blows is a 450-range burst around herself with true damage on the edge, and Lillia has no dash in her kit at all. The actual decisive interaction — Lilting Lullaby only sleeps enemies already carrying Dream Dust — was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q is 'activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge'; R 'causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy'. A reader told to chase a dash that does not exist will misread every trade.
audit.corrected: Real names restored, the bounce/dash invention removed, and the Dream Dust precondition on her ultimate written into key interactions and the level-6 spike.

edits.before: Your R (Leap of Faith) tentacle field out-damages her R (Lilting Aria) sleep in a straight stand-up brawl, so if you force the all-in before she gets distance you still win the fight.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust, so if she has not landed a spell on you her R does nothing — force the brawl inside your tentacle field before she chips you.

edits.before: Lillia scales into a mobile map-roaming AP threat who never has to sit in your tentacles; she pokes with Q (Blooming Blast) and disengages, so the lane advantage decays.
edits.after: Lillia scales into a mobile map-roaming AP threat who never sits in your tentacles; Blooming Blows stacks her move speed on every hit, so she chips and leaves and your lead decays.

edits.before: Level 1 Lillia can poke with her Q bounces and passive true damage while you have no dash, so respect her until you get W; from Level 2 onward you swing back and punish any greedy step-in.
edits.after: Level 1 Lillia pokes with Blooming Blows — its edge deals true damage — while you have no way to close, so respect her until you get W; from Level 2 you swing back and punish any greedy step-in.

edits.before: Use W to stick after she Q-dashes away
Kite the E tether with Q (Blooming Blast) bounce and passive move speed
edits.after: Stack move speed with Blooming Blows and kill the spirit fast

edits.before: Land R (Lilting Aria) sleep to reset any all-in
edits.after: Land Lilting Lullaby sleep to reset any all-in

edits.before: Her kite + move speed stacks. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 and stacks her move speed each hit.

edits.before: Track Lillia's Blooming Blows: Her kite + move speed stacks. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps you if her spells already marked you with Dream Dust — stay clean and her R is idle.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Blooming Blows and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. You own levels 2 through 6; from her first item on she stops standing in the tentacles at all.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Lillia carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Favoured early — difficulty 5/10, Lillia carry threat 8/10.

notes: Two invented ability names on this page ('Blooming Blast', 'Lilting Aria') plus an invented dash — the page told readers to chase a Q-dash Lillia does not have. All fixed. wants.foe[0] previously said she kites out of the tether; Riot's Test of Spirit text is explicit that getting too far from the spirit turns the target into a Vessel, so it now says she wants to kill the spirit rather than run from it.Many full-layer strings still call Lillia 'he/him'; left for a pronoun sweep.
